proposed_message.subject: Quick note about your listing on AllAIDunia
proposed_message.body:
Hi ChatGPT team,

I hope this message finds you well! I wanted to let you know that ChatGPT is featured on AllAIDunia (https://www.allaidunia.com/), a directory of AI tools that we’re really excited about. You can check out your listing here: https://www.allaidunia.com/#chatgpt.

If you’re open to it, we’d be so grateful if you could include a link back to us from your site, perhaps on a "featured on" or resources page. Of course, we’d be more than happy to return the favor with a link from our listing to any page you’d like on your site.

No worries if it’s not possible, and thank you for creating such an incredible tool with ChatGPT!

Warm regards,
AllAIDunia Team

proposed_message.subject: Exciting Opportunity for Midjourney on AllAIDunia!
proposed_message.body:
Hi Midjourney team,

I hope this message finds you well! I wanted to reach out because we have Midjourney listed on AllAIDunia (https://www.allaidunia.com/#midjourney), and I’m thrilled to share that we’re offering some new featured placement options to help you gain even more visibility.

Here’s a quick overview:
- **Featured Listing** — $49/mo: Top-of-category placement, a "Featured" badge, and priority in our AI Tool Matchmaker results.
- **Homepage Spotlight** — $99/mo: A rotating banner on our homepage plus all benefits of the Featured Listing.
- **Category Sponsor** — $149/mo: Exclusive top placement in one category, ensuring no competitors share the spotlight, along with all Homepage Spotlight benefits.

We’re really keeping this to a small group for now, and I’d love to hear your thoughts. If this doesn’t feel like the right fit at the moment, no pressure at all!

Warm regards,
The AllAIDunia Team
